t: customData/elements/Item/text
I feel like Zayan enjoys sending me on missions. In any case, this mission is surprisingly simple.
customData/elements/Item/text
The vampires have gone completely mad. They locked themselves inside Amarantha and are plotting some secret business. All this with the locals’ assisstance. That works to our advantage.
customData/elements/Item/text
We need to examine everything that looks even a little suspicious. This could all be an illusion... Or there is just a stone covering the entrance. Or an illusion of a stone.
customData/elements/Item/text
Wow, the vampires worked hard to make this place less... Abandoned looking. Are they sleeping or something?
Worms-on-faces come and die! Now more meatbag stranger come! Also die! They die!
customData/elements/Item/text
You can’t get lost here, but we should be careful. I don't believe the draconids only left a few squads here...
A gruesome fate... I will go to the Keepers and ask them for help getting the animals out of here. See you there.
customData/elements/Item/text
Don’t fear, little creature, I will save you all... I will bring everyone home...
customData/elements/Item/text
Well. This is dangerous. Eloise and our deceased friend must experience deadly magic. Everyone ready?
customData/elements/Item/text
Oh, there are so many ghosts here... I’ll move to the former central camp at the top of the hill, and you try to get there carefully and investigate the area along the way. We’ll rendezvous there.
customData/elements/Item/text
As you found out, now this whole place is Nihaz’s abandoned theater. It seems he hasn’t been here for some time.
customData/elements/Item/text
Creepy and calm. On the one hand, Gipat is very consistent, nothing changes here year after year, but that consistency... It’s unnatural.
customData/elements/Item/text
Didn’t that worry the ancient necromancers? In this war we’ll have to do without excessive moralism. At least we’ll give them the chance take revenge on their captor.
customData/elements/Item/text
You’re not used to this yet? The idea here is the same as always – we need to hide our plans from both Nihaz and the rest of the world.
customData/elements/Item/text
First, as usual, we use the magiscope, and then... Look for something strange. See, Gipat simply can’t be free of mysteries.
customData/elements/Item/text
So that’s on you. All this time there hasn’t been anything you couldn't break. This mission is about improvisation, so improvise!
Lose? I do have something lose, Zayan... You consider yourself wise, but where do you lead those who follow you? Are you sure you aren’t dancing to a Dark God's tune?
customData/elements/Item/text
Hiero, are you blinded by duty? We are not doing this for ourselves! Each of us is sacrificing much! Don’t you have something to lose?! Wake up!
They say a great united Convocation is coming. The churches of the Empire and the League are uniting! They’re even doing away with the anathemas!
How is old Forox, dwelling of the Light? I can remember my hometown, our Cathedral, Brother Ivan, and the statue of Saint Brian...
customData/elements/Item/text
Who is the Prioress on Umoir? Ah yes, it's Hope Brightley...
Wow, what a welcome you have prepared for me... But I am not here to chat, Wigo.
customData/elements/Item/text
These cowards around me don’t help anymore. They are too afraid of your power. And I’m clever enough to know I cannot win this fight.
All I can say is that our little friend still knows how to choose patrons. Time for me to find some stronger allies... See you around.
customData/elements/Item/text
You can’t hide your cowardice behind theatrics, Wigo... Oh, what a pitiful sight.
Apparently, there are no strong vampires left, if Wigo was the only one worthy of leading the others in my absence.
I know you're hoping for a fight, but that won’t happen. Wigo is too scared to fight me. Other vampires won’t dare stand against me.
customData/elements/Item/text
Okay, come now, there are more problems to solve... Now comes the moment of triumph and greatness. For me, of course. You get to watch.
customData/elements/Item/text
I must admit, you did good work. Both to help me and to save the world you know from this Nihaz.
customData/elements/Item/text
SILENCE! You've come too far! Why are you here? Why do you disturb those long passed? They fought enough in life!
customData/elements/Item/text
I don't want to know anything about it. The problems of the living have not concerned us for some time. You must go, whether you want to or not.
customData/elements/Item/text
I am not that stupid. I know you are strong. I will not fight you. Not here and not like that. But I will stop you with mind, not strength.
NO! I will not let you both defile this place with your sorcery! First I will crush your protector and then you, Dakkar!
He did that to me last time... It hurt!
customData/elements/Item/text
Why are you standing there, rookies? Go clean the droppings out of the hold! And I don’t want a single squirrel on board, or I’ll dump you in the astral!
customData/elements/Item/text
That bastard killed my good buddy on a bridge. Made poor fellow quake at his name for three days after resurrecting...
customData/elements/Item/text
Even if we gather an army, the darkness will corrupt them. Unless it's a Zem army or... just the undead.
customData/elements/Item/text
I could get it for you. If your Summoner is as good as you say, it will give us a chance at victory.
customData/elements/Item/text
Good. But you'd better hurry. As soon as I find a way to remove the Seal, the army should be ready.
customData/elements/Item/text
Are you done? Great. So we can continue to disable generators... But talk to me first.
customData/elements/Item/text
What a fight! You did it. Great. We need to discuss our course of action! Our further progress is impeded.
customData/elements/Item/text
Sisters always stuck together, whispering among themselves. Grumpida, Crankida... There was another sister.
customData/elements/Item/text
I don’t know... She was in a hurry and didn't want to be bothered. It must be something urgent.
customData/elements/Item/text
Hm... Well, if it's urgent, then give it here. I hope Galenel finds someone to stand in for me during the ritual.
customData/elements/Item/text
You are forgetting yourself, old summoner! Remember how our last meeting ended? Let the elf go or I'll remind you!
They seem to be in a deep trance... Shall we begin?
customData/elements/Item/text
Some things shouldn't be hurried, Charmeye. One of the greatest relics of Yazes is before us - the scroll of Urd, the Soul Eater...
customData/elements/Item/text
We must exercise caution. Let's start with focusing our consciousness. Free your mind and let the magic fill you...
customData/elements/Item/text
Well, that's Jade! He sells the best wine to ghouls, but we get nothing. Take it and tell him to go live with the bloodsuckers if he loves them so much.
customData/elements/Item/text
Oh, damn... hiccup! It was a treat, so I... hiccup...! accepted it. Take the bottle and don't tell anyone I had it... hiccup!
customData/elements/Item/text
It says "Red Hightown wine - 25 pcs." on the box, but there are only 17 left, and two got broken. Where's the rest?!
customData/elements/Item/text
Homespun fabrics, seven pieces... So there should be seven, but there are only four on the cart!
Moon was rising, it was calm and peaceful... When will I finish my poem?
customData/elements/Item/text
Where are you going? Off to visit your bloodsuckers?
It's dark enough now. We should start while the locals are asleep.
customData/elements/Item/text
You've done well. The locals are convinced they're in danger. Soon they'll see it with their own eyes.
customData/elements/Item/text
Unless someone stops us. Today someone took down my amulets and dispersed the bullies. It's outrageous.
customData/elements/Item/text
And you, sister... Why are you so kind to the traitor? Don't you share my pain? That's fine. I'll show you...
Some idiot who walks around smelling random things... We'll kill him later, leave him for now. And you go stand over there, girl. I'm reading the plants...
Genevieve, off with you. I'll be brief. Today I realized that humans will never accept us. We must get stronger.
You repaired our cloning equipment, and thanks to Genevieve, we can use it for a good cause.
customData/elements/Item/text
Go, clone.
This is our first triumph. A clone that follows orders and costs little to produce.
No one saw him lurking, but everyone knew a war was on; they were afraid...
Of Love and Evil: The Minds of Cecilia... What a mysterious story. No time to read, the world needs saving...
customData/elements/Item/text
Center of the Moon... Interesting...
A prey? You are lying, Scar. This cub has eyes of a hunter and a fearless heart. He will be a part of the Pack!
Listen to me, Pack, and don't say you haven't been told! The young cub calls himself a hunter. Who else thinks he is one?
customData/elements/Item/text

I was on Winter Watch,

 The Urun came like a storm,

 And when I hid in the snow,

 Glorious warriors saved Gerda!
customData/elements/Item/text
Sigus the Long Mustache… Great-great-great-great… and maybe one more “great-” grandfather. He was a warden in Skalgard. Left the Pattern in 885.
customData/elements/Item/text
Vetri the Skier - he went around the whole of Isa. Also my ancestor - and it’s scary to say in what generation. His Fate came about in 841.
customData/elements/Item/text
Driva the White Braid was a brave warrior. She went on an eternal journey after the battle with the Urun! It was... in 823.
Broddie Stalwart: A new age of Isa begins, and we will reconnect with our lost brothers and sisters!
customData/elements/Item/subtitles/Item/text
Broddie Stalwart: So let us raise our cups to that!
customData/elements/Item/text
When I come back, I can restore the true order of things. I will avenge the descendants of those who interrupted my path...
customData/elements/Item/text
For your children. They will help you. We will call upon the forces from beyond this world, the forces of the gods that fought Hirkalla. They will free you. There is hope.
customData/elements/Item/text
Remember that no matter what happens, no matter how fate changes, you will always be welcome here on Isa.
customData/elements/Item/subtitles/Item/text
Kharyskhan: Fear me, Gibberlings, for I am your nightmare who came from the darkness of ages! Remember this day!
customData/elements/Item/text
Phew, it looks like everything is ready. Now it should sit for a bit... but if your wooden girlfriend can speed up the process, then I hope she will help us here, too?
customData/elements/Item/text
It's an honor to participate in the brewing of mead, so be thankful to these wanderers that we're doing it a second time this year! And now - let's brew mead!
customData/elements/Item/text
We can speak with the goddess! I can sense that the Tree has its own mind and its thoughts are linked with hers. But it won't be easy...
customData/elements/Item/text
Aho, friend! I'm still glad to see you in this hour of shared misfortune. Welcome to Howlem, my homeland.
Makchirgue: I bow to you, guest. May your wisdom be like the full moon that shines bright in the darkness.
Praise be to you, wanderer. May your paths be as light as the paths of the wind.
customData/elements/Item/text
It's been a while since I've had a chance to jump using Vegvisir. I hope we get there without any problems, but be ready for anything, little friends.
customData/elements/Item/elements/Item/text
It's unpleasant, yes. We have a riot here, all thanks to one person we both know, and I'm asking you for help again.
customData/elements/Item/text
I warned you all, but no one listened to me. I told you you were heading straight into the trap of the Dark God.
customData/elements/Item/text
He is cunning, as an owl is cunning in the night. He lies in wait for you on many paths, and very few of those are straight paths.
customData/elements/Item/text
Everything you have done, everything you have devised - he knew about it in advance, for his capabilities are not the capabilities of mortals, but the powers of God.
customData/elements/Item/text
He persuaded you to do what he wanted with false promises, he put tools in your hands so you could forge your own chain...
customData/elements/Item/text
Praise the Light! I thought you'd never wake up! Everyone knows you should stay away from dark creatures.
customData/elements/Item/text
Voice in the head: Can you hear me, worm? I remember you... You won't catch me off-guard, won't steal my Spark again!
customData/elements/Item/text
It says here, "He was not of rank exalted, he was not of noble birth. He was bred among the people in the breast of Mother Earth..."
customData/elements/Item/text
"He set out to teach the people freedom, love, equality."
customData/elements/Item/text
It says here, "To exhort them to resistance. But to flee the penalty of the prison, whip and gallows, to a foreign land he went."
customData/elements/Item/text
"While the people waited eager for his coming to rebel against their fate."
customData/elements/Item/text
It says here, "To arise and crush the Tsardom and the nobles' vicious hate."
customData/elements/Item/text
"To share all the wealth in common, and the antiquated thrall of the church, the home, and marriage to abolish once for all."
Now add Essence of Destruction and Essence of Creation, then add Essence of Life to improve the reaction.
customData/elements/Item/text
Nezeb! Yasker betrayed...! Must report...! Oh... my head... Fate is a lie! Lie! Don't believe it! It's all deceit and conspiracy... conspiracy of spiders...
customData/elements/Item/text
The disgruntled awakened have already gathered near the Cathedral where the bulk of my sister's guard is.
Hirkalla: Who else are you going to use and deceive now? Neither the Light nor the crowd of these ungrateful parasites helped you...
Tep: An imperfect universe that will be remade. Your powers, the powers of the gods, must be mine...
Tep: Your existence is meaningless. Only I know the true plan. And now I will begin to execute it. All worlds will know the power of the GOD OF DEATH TEP!
The warriors of light are now fighting with the guard, but it's the awakened ones who are suffering...
It's not first time something like this has happened, right? She has kept things from you before.
We found the third person whose fate was stolen. In the previous version of reality, he was a war hero, a famous commander. Let's see who he is now.
These ghosts were promised final resurrection, but that promise was never fulfilled.
Alice wants chaos in her sister's domain: she's using you and everyone else to achieve her ends.
customData/elements/Item/elements/Item/text
Ah, what a rhino! A fine one! If I were the master of the house and had a herd of three hundred rhinos, I would give half of them for such a steed!
customData/elements/Item/elements/Item/text
Tell Pechorin that our agreement has been fulfilled! I said I would do it, so it shall be done!
customData/elements/Item/text
Sometimes friends are worse than enemies. Enemies are more honest, but friends like this will cut our throats at night and disappear. I love enemies, but not friends.
customData/elements/Item/text
To none has my love brought happiness, but who knows what will happen? What must be will be. Find her.
customData/elements/Item/text
Great, now we can leave this place. The Well is still full, so I think Cosmos should have no reason to be upset. I didn't take all the energy after all.
customData/elements/Item/text
I'm getting ready to take off. The Sculptor is going to wake up now, and we'll be overrun. We just need to hold on for a minute!
customData/elements/Item/subtitles/Item/text
Perfect! The Well's power should be more than enough. But I don't want to be interrupted - let the jinns put up a protective barrier!
customData/elements/Item/subtitles/Item/text
Hirkalla: The Light has suffered another defeat, and we got two mages for the price of one. It's a great day. We are going back to Jigran.
customData/elements/Item/text
Hirkalla: Nihaz's Seal. Only Nezeb can reinhabit his own body. While I'm busy with the ritual, I can't be distracted - so make sure no one interrupts me.
customData/elements/Item/text
Hmm... A terrible murder! The father of the family was killed, the accused is his own son! What is the reason? The mistress or money?
customData/elements/Item/text
Hmm. A funny incident: the widow of the doctor who shot himself opened a sewing workshop where she gathered women who had run away from their families and began to live as a community!
Wanted: Seven peasants who fled their villages, allegedly for the purpose of conducting a sociological survey. What changes await us?
customData/elements/Item/text
I can't stand change! I'm tired of all this bustle.
customData/elements/Item/text
Thanks to you, Light entered my life, became protection and support. Let it be the same for you...
customData/elements/Item/elements/Item/text
Oh, you should take a closer look, you don't understand how much beauty nature has to offer! Put a lightning rod here!
Go! And remember - the defense must fall! This annoying cabal of bigots and fanatics is a pain in my ass.
customData/elements/Item/text
Oh, we are looking at a love triangle. She was sweet on her father's servant, but an unexpected guest ruined all plans.
customData/elements/Item/text
The wretched times! I don't know where to begin! People grow wise before their years. Knowledge is the plague of life.
customData/elements/Item/text
The lord is angry, so everyone left, and the whole house is in disarray. Who is to blame? Petrusha, of course
customData/elements/Item/text
I cannot bear the pains I feel. I'm suffering a million torments. The liar laughed at me! People like Molchalin have it all! Bring the coach!
customData/elements/Item/text
I'm an honest officer! There are many ways to earn a rank. There are vacancies, I just want to be a general...

Yes, and I am in need of additional personnel, by the way. The "New Reality" project is not a reason to forget about space!
customData/elements/Item/text
Grand horizons and magnificient achievements of science lay ahead! Let us make that which we could only dream of a reality!
customData/elements/Item/text
Here it is! I knew it! They really do exist! That's an alien! A Horned Three-Eyed Brain Eater! Now we need for everyone to learn the truth!
customData/elements/Item/text
Have we really got out? Before today, I was thwarted every time... But now, luck is on our side! We need to find my shelter now...
customData/elements/Item/text
That's it – we're out of their reach, they won't be able to stop us here... We need to tell the entire world about the alien!
customData/elements/Item/text
Time to unveil the truth and rip away the shroud of lies that our government has been spreading, for years now, through the media! We need to tell everyone what is real!
customData/elements/Item/text
"Rutess for every cheni" is an interesting idea, but it still sounds trashy! Come on now, my kinspeople are waiting...
customData/elements/Item/text
Has Shereda come back home? What a sweety, my daughter. When she was a child, she would often run away and hide among the tombs...
customData/elements/Item/text
customData/elements/Item/text
I'm not causing any mischief, just repairing the stove − and I feel obliged to remind you the cats are ancient, inviolate animals.
customData/elements/Item/text
Why are you looking at me like that? We cats have our own ways... Just as Nihaz used to say: "No cat, no life!"
customData/elements/Item/text
Determining behavior model for "human" type objects... "Altruism" model selected. Testing behavior model...
customData/elements/Item/text
Result: Integral wishes to selflessly inflict good on humans. Do you want to join with the Integral's divine sentience? (Yes/No)
customData/elements/Item/text
My victims must thank me. Their beauty will be perpetuated in my perfection! My faithful, let's be finished with them!
customData/elements/Item/text
You must watch the indicators! As soon as their color changes, use the nearest console to reposition the rods at once!
Nomarkh Jezerith: Nefer Ur is not expecting this! We've managed to connect to the portal network, and we can now get directly to Sar-Iram...
Nomarkh Jezerith: Master, your task has been completed! We are ready to go to Xadagan on your instruction!
Nomarkh Jezerith: I bow before your wisdom, Master! What do we do with the captives? I think we should finish them...
Tep: Set off immediately, we need to thwart Nefer Ur's efforts! The Wireframe project must be stopped. Other groups will be joining you soon.
customData/elements/Item/text
Your outlook is too pessimistic! We've been incredibly successful, our Ray of Life will bring about the revolution in science! I entrust conducting the final tests to you...
Reanimated Necro-Rhino
customData/elements/Item/text
Science knows no way to transform beasts into humans. See, I've tried it, but failed.

Fury... Crazystorm's daughter, if you know him... It's thanks to her that Kurgan has the Merciless clan on his side now.
Alas, Orcs don't really respect age and experience. They think Crazystorm is too old, and Fury has charisma!
And Kurgan himself decided to become a prophet: he says the June portal on Suslanger will bring the new Legendary Orc here!
Now you understand why the Orcs greeted you like that? They have been sitting in the desert for months, waiting.
customData/elements/Item/text
I hope we'll reach our destination without incidents this time...
customData/elements/Item/text
I kno... believe that the Orcs have a part to play in this story. So have patience: you saved Fury, and she won't forget that.
customData/elements/Item/text
Let's see if you can find your way around the city. The garden we need is behind the Tower in the square across the bridge from us.
customData/elements/Item/text
Like the grandfather of my grandfather used to say, the desert is treacherous... One moment the bright sun shines in the sky, then suddenly a fierce wind rises up, tearing the skin off your bones...
customData/elements/Item/text
But the desert is also generous! Its riches are boundless, you only need to know how to find them... Wise elders know how to find water there...
customData/elements/Item/text
...but water is not the only treasure... I know ancient artifacts are hidden in the desert. Artifacts created by Great Nezeb, praise his name!
customData/elements/Item/text
And the luckiest ones will find these treasures! But you must be careful, because the desert guards its secrets!
customData/elements/Item/text
I'll tell you about ancient legends... About something that none of the living has seen for a long time. It is true that the Brotherhood of the Last Shelter once existed on Suslanger.
customData/elements/Item/text
And it was founded by those who did not tolerate the whip, did not want to break their backs at the plantations, who dreamed of being free in every sense of the word!
customData/elements/Item/text
The Brotherhood was founded by runaway slaves and exiles. They lived in caves, as there are dozens of them in the area.
customData/elements/Item/text
They knew how to get away from the guards quietly so no one noticed. And it's not the only thing the Brotherhood was famous for. They kept countless treasures stolen from Nezeb.
customData/elements/Item/text
There's a place called the Court of Miracles. It's called that way for a reason: the place is indeed full of miracles. A lame person will start walking normally there, ha ha!
customData/elements/Item/text
But it's not the only miracle. The Gray Prince rules the place, the most cunning man in the whole of Sarnaut. There's no one wealthier than the Prince in the world!
customData/elements/Item/text
There are caves filled with treasures at the Court of Miracles... And the piles keep growing! That's the story... Spare a coin for the poor orphan!
customData/elements/Item/text

Let's see what we have here... I think I heard noises coming from somewhere ahead. Let's be on our guard.

There should be a hidden entrance here...
customData/elements/Item/text

There... Look... There's a large entrance ahead! Maybe it's what we're looking for...

But a jinn is guarding it...
Exodus of Jinns
customData/elements/Item/text
They say Trunk himself spent a vacation here, is that right? I once wrote him a letter... Like, where is the new stuff? We are not getting anything!
Suslanger is the perfect place to hide something, but honestly, I'm already sick of the sand! I'm going to the glacier!
customData/elements/Item/subtitles/Item/text
Kurgan the Crafty: He is Skulnar the Fierce, the reborn Legendary Orc and our leader! Chief, a speech for your people!
And if that wasn't enough, the Unyielding family, our brothers, got tired of waiting for the Legendary Orc. They have gone off their rocker when Fury let you go.
Someone also stole some water and a bunch of parts during your escape... I don't know what to do, I hope you and Fury will come up with something.
customData/elements/Item/text
And I'll probably leave my post anyway, just don’t tell anyone. For years, I've had no idea what life is like outside the Landfill...
I'd like to see how it influences other creatures in this desert...
customData/elements/Item/text
We'll have something to discuss with the guys at the biological station! Perhaps we'll even get the Imperial award!
What sits at the bottom of the sea and twitches? A nervous wreck.
customData/elements/Item/text
Knock-knock! - Who's there? An Astral Academy student! What are you doing in the Igsh Military District? - I failed my mid-term exams...
I saw a guy spill all his Astrabble tiles on the road. I asked him, "What's the word on the street?"
customData/elements/Item/text

Twelve heroes storm the domain

Of Nihaz who only craves destruction.

Hedus blocks their path.

The red banner is raised, a battle begins,

And this time Fate is not favorable.

One warrior calls on higher powers,

An elven maiden appears before him.

The heroes did not win victory.

A grave robber named Lara

Suddenly comes to mind.

The girl read on some tablets

That the world is facing imminent doom.

Frightened, she decided to look for ways

To avert the end of the world.

She asked heroes to complete tasks,

But it was all a joke of the Junes.

A tavern owner in Novograd lost her husband

And started looking for another.

She is good at everything - how come she has no luck?

She gets rejected time and again.

The woman is just too amorous,

Often beyond measure.

In the end, she found a gray-haired veteran

Who now keeps a firm rein on his wife.

On the land that is called holy, there was a bloody slaughter.

Seeking a way to win victory,

The Empire and the League turned to the Traders.

Cunning Goblins offered them Holy Weapons.

Khador from Gipat, also known as Bully,

Was tired of being a ghost - the poor man was bored.

He demanded this:

A body must be found for him urgently.

The Wormfaces found a solution:

The Spark would possess the body of a vampire cultist.

Khador was happy until he looked

Into his pants and marveled at what he saw.

On Isa, in the cold lands where the Urun roam

Gerda joins the Winter Watch.

Spotting the Urun, she hides in a snowdrift

It's a miracle she is rescued in time.

The time of brave heroes has come.

Dragons cannot hide from the gaze of the merciless Junes.

In response to the threat, the dragons formed an alliance among themselves

Villages are burned down, cities are turned into ruins.

But here come the children of the June genius.

War machines made of metal and stone - Golems.

A dragon's wrath cannot withstand this force.

Defeated, they retreat, and the Junes are now at peace.

The burden of war is borne by the Aro tribes and Orcs.

For years, the enmity does not subside, and people fall into despair.

But difficult times give rise to great heroes - Tensess, Nezeb, and Skrakan.

After uniting the people, they defeat the horde and drive them back.

But victory alone was not enough for the heroes.

They went to the lands of the horde to put an end to the threat.

The insidious Sevia helped them along the way.

The leader Skulnar was defeated, and the horde was no more.

Nezeb, a son of the Empire, lusted for glory.

He led his army to the Kanian lands and subjugated many.

The grave threat loomed over the land. Heeding the call,

Tensess came to the rescue, shining in the greatness of his power.

A mysterious Seal of Mystery falls on Umoir.

In attempts to solve the mystery,

Brave heroes disappear one by one.

The last four heroes begin their journey,

Coming from distant corners of the land.

Brian and Rud Glaen join them, swearing eternal loyalty.

And together they defeat the demon - the Seal is finally gone.

Skrakan was liberated and the sun rose over Umoir.

Yazes was shrouded in shadows: the age of tyranny arrived.

The vile Urd had usurped the throne, and the people suffered under oppression.

The crown was broken, the radiance of three stars illuminated the heavens.

But then a sorceress sent by Skrakan appeared.

Brave Iglez, courageous Dina, and Galenel -

Together, they went through forests and deserts,

Looking for fragments. When they found them, they uncovered the secret of

Terrible necromancers, and peace was restored.

In the icy land. He found the girl and fell in love.

The trouble was, she had a fiancé, but he had disappeared.

He followed the man's tracks to Suslanger

But found nothing and went back - and it turned out that he was the fiancé.

The ancient people stubbornly sought immortality -

They were horrified by the death of the Junes.

But they were instructed to fear such daring desires.

And punishment descended on the lands of Hickut.

A terrible disease struck the entire nation,

And there was no cure in the world for this scourge.

Over several moons, millions of unfortunates died.

Only the wind blowed sand across the ruins of Hickut.

Nezeb and Tensess - heroes, great men.

Their friendship, once strong like stone,

Was destroyed by a lust for power.

Crows are circling over Kania - there will be a terrible battle.

Pride, a child of vice, poisoned the souls of the mages.

They decided to become equal to the gods, breaking the covenants.

Great power is hidden in the Seals of Nihaz.

The Twelve must take possession of it and rule the world.

But the gods are harsh towards arrogant mortals

And they send down punishment upon the world.

The ground is broken, and many mages perish

The living became gods - kings of the rubble.

Blessed Ammer, home of the bright Aoidoi.

Suffering from demons, the allod is covered by corruption

Brave Kyros and Ellona try to fight them off.

Creatures of the astral plane must be defeated.

But the creatures knew the power of dark magic

That extinguished sparks. When Ellona died,

She could not be resurrected, and Kyros

Plunged into great sorrow, becoming a faithful servant of the Wanderer.

On dusty Grok, where the Orcs roamed, lived Lorzub.

His clan was called the Merciless, and he was unused to hardships.

He was chosen by the Elven mage Elleken.

Changed by the power of the deities, the Orc acquired magic abilities.

Sensing trouble, he fled from the Elves.

After returning to the tribe, he disappeared with his bride.

But he could not escape. He fell in battle.

However, his bloodline was secretly continued.

Nezeb and Skrakan gathered ships, countless warriors,

Mighty mages, and the astral campaign began.

Demon hordes fell one by one.

But the army died there after destroying the portal for nothing.

The roar of the great battle comes.

Two forces collide, tearing into each other.

The mad god Sarn, who yearns for freedom,

And the Architect, the ruler of order.

It happened by the will of one maiden -

One with flame-colored hair.

Her enemies were the god and the creator,

And now they want to destroy each other.

A troop of heroes pursuit the fallen

Son of Ammer known as Kyros.

They bravely step onto the Secret Paths.

Simargl rules there - he is the ruler of secrets.

The heroes are overwhelmed by mysteries,

But they are strong both in body and mind.

The secrets are solved, the guardian is defeated -

A great feat is accomplished.

Oh, let us remember the accomplishments of the heroes of the past.

How they outwitted the god of battles.

They gained his favor,

Listening to advice from the other world.

That force sent them to arenas

To win or be defeated.

Even though it was no heroic feat,

There was a reward for the worthy.

After kidnapping a maiden, a huge Tungar tribe went into hiding.

There was no way to get into the cave.

A new plan was devised

By the cunning hunter Murk who wanted to save Elena.

After collecting fire-spitting lizards,

They saddled a yak, steering it towards the Tungars.

With fire roaring around them, they rode in bravely, sending everyone fleeing.

They saved Elena and found the way up.

The queen's desire was

To help those dear to her.

An artifact, the legacy of the Elves, was given away.

In the icy desert, the trace of the Blood Bond was lost.

An investigation pointed towards the killer.

A lie was distinguished from the truth, and evidence was obtained.

After catching the snake in the snow, the heroes recovered the stolen goods.

They returned those to the queen before the ball, and her honor was preserved.

Discovering only nightmares there,

The heroes went with a different plan, turning to a sage.

He was a gray-haired jinn named Khottab.

He set the heroes on the girl's trail.
